description: This pie chart illustrates a comparison between two categories, displaying both time values in seconds and their corresponding percentages. The chart consists of a total of two slices. The larger slice, colored orange, is labeled "Reduction" and accounts for 60.9s, or 69.92% of the total. The smaller slice, colored blue, is labeled "Efficient deployment" and represents 26.2s, or 30.08%. The blue slice is visually emphasized by being exploded, or slightly offset, from the main body of the pie. The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, the category labels are positioned just outside the slices, while the specific time values and percentage labels enclosed in parentheses are displayed directly inside their respective segments.
